content.title: Cameron Young Net Worth 2025: How Much Money Does He Make?
content.text: Cameron Young is one of the most talented professional golfers in recent times. He recently became the center of attention on social media after he bagged his first PGA Tour title on Sunday, August 3, 2025. Here are all the details fans need to know about Young’s net worth in 2025 and how much money he makes from his sources of income. What is Cameron Young’s net worth in 2025? Cameron Young has a speculated net worth of $18 million in 2025. Young’s net worth in 2025 consists of earnings from his stint as a golfer and first PGA Tour title winnings. He is best known for his performance at the recent PGA Tour and being crowned the Rookie of the Year for the 2021-2022 season. What does Cameron Young do for a living? Cameron Young is a golfer by profession. Most recently, Young won his maiden PGA Tour title. According to a report by AP News, he won the Wyndham Championship with just six shots. After winning, the golfer got visibly emotional and said, “I’ve been waiting for it for a while. I never thought I’d be that emotional about it. But it’s the end of my fourth season. I’ve had my chances, and I wasn’t going to let it get away from me.” He also expressed his desire to compete in the Ryder Cup. Cameron Young’s earnings explained — how does he make money? Cameron Young earns money from his career as a golfer. Young’s net worth witnessed an immense growth as he bagged the prize money of $1,476,000 at the recent PGA Tour. After turning professional in 2019, he has won numerous times and bagged the prize money, which has led to an increase in his fortune. His salary on average is about $3.2 million. During the 2021-2022 season, Young became the highest-earning rookie in a single season with approximately $10 million despite competing in less than 50 games. This money consisted of $4.19 million from the official events, $2.32 million from participating in major championships, $2.2 million from PIP, $660k from the Tour Championships, and $1.1 million from the Top 10 Tour. In the 2023 season, he made around $5.9 million, whereas his largest paycheck this season was $2.2 million. During the 2024 season, Young earned around $4.24 million. His total career earnings amount to $23.2 million as of February 2025. In the 2025 season, he has currently made around $779k. Young also became the ambassador of the global fintech company, iCapital.
